"""Independent validation of unresolved subnormal-output/midpoint cases."""
import argparse,json
from pathlib import Path
import torch,torch_npu
from kernels.projects.a5.pgdn_fused_recurrent.verify_native import public,measured_outputs,compare
from kernels.projects.a5.pgdn_fused_recurrent.ref.reference import make_inputs,reference
from kernels.projects.a5.pgdn_fused_recurrent.ref.oracle import oracle
from ascend_fla.ops.pgdn_fused_recurrent import prepare
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--block-dim',type=int,required=True);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
torch.set_num_threads(1);torch.npu.set_device(0);prepare(block_dim=a.block_dim)
a.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);rows=[]
for i,(gate,mag) in enumerate([(-94.10157775878906,1e30),(-95.60408020019531,1e30),(-100.,1.),(-90.,1.)]):
 case=dict(id=f'precision_{i}',B=1,S=1,H=16,HV=32,state='random',atk='random',g_atk=gate,beta_atk=0.,atk_scale=mag,dtype='float32',seed=959000+i)
 data=make_inputs(case);refs=dict(A=oracle(data),B=reference(data));dev={n:None if x is None else x.to('npu') for n,x in data.items()}
 actual=measured_outputs(lambda x:public(x,a.block_dim),dev,data);row=dict(case=case,comparison=compare(actual,refs));rows.append(row)
 torch.save(dict(inputs=data,actual=actual,references=refs),a.output/(case['id']+'.pt'))
 print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
(a.output/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(stage='native_precision_boundaries',records=rows,passed=all(x['comparison']['passed'] for x in rows)),indent=2)+'\n')
raise SystemExit(0 if all(x['comparison']['passed'] for x in rows) else 1)
